titulo: DEVO v2 — Corvo, retrato em pose (meio corpo, ref. Persona)
prompt: Bold clean anime lineart, two-tone cel shading, high-contrast graphic poster style. Half-body portrait from mid-thigh up, plain flat medium grey background, headroom above the head. A very tall gaunt hooded figure bends forward in three-quarter view as if over a well; his bare bony left hand, palm down at chest height, lets a small old coin drop from its fingertips, relaxed hand, five fingers clearly separated; his gloved right hand with iron claw tips holds the cloak closed. Deep pointed black hood drooping back like a perched crow's head; inside, a cracked bone-white crow-skull half mask with a long downward beak, one glowing teal eye on the viewer's left, the other socket dark, only shadow below the beak. Black crow-feather capelet with teal-sheened tips and an iron bird-skull clasp; long black cloak lined with teal-sheened feathers; bare forearm turning from bluish dead skin into aged bone; small iron crow with an amethyst eye on the shoulder on the viewer's right. Pale teal will-o'-the-wisp light from below. Palette: black #0C0C0E, teal #3A9FB0, aged bone #D9D0BC. No text, letters or logos anywhere.
negative: text, letters, watermark, logo, blurry, low detail, pixel art, extra fingers, extra limbs
